title: Orb photo showing Chris's lost child

tellings.quote: fact, I have a child. My wife and I lost a child. We have four, but we lost a child. And I was out thinking about him. And um this lonely orb there it comes [snorts] and I took a picture of it and and there was a child.

plain: One night a lone glowing orb appeared while he was outside thinking about the son he and his wife had lost, and when he photographed it, "there was a child" in the picture. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he sees such lights, tells Michels this happened to him, which would mean the orb answered his grief.
